title: Do LLMs Favor LLMs? Quantifying Interaction Effects in Peer Review

bias_targets.methodology: Observational analysis of over 125,000 peer-review pairs (ICLR, NeurIPS, ICML) using regression with area correction and within-paper paired comparisons, combined with synthetic experiments using fully LLM-generated reviews and metareviews, to quantify if LLM-assisted reviewers systematically assign higher ratings to LLM-assisted papers compared to fully human-written papers.
